To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the interpersonal function of grammar is best understood in terms of interactional frames, (b) grammatical constructions are best understood in terms, and (c) grammatical constructions can be analyzed in terms of the interactional frames that they realize and the interactional frames can be analyzed in the terms of grammatical constructions that they realize.

1) the communicative contexts of interactional frames are crucial for understanding grammatical constructions and 2) the interpersonal function of grammar and its contribution to the dynamics of meaning-making are crucial for understanding interactional frames.
interactive frames and grammars are implicated in the construction of interpersonal meanings.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways in which the grammatical structure of a text reflects and is shaped by the communicative context in which it is embedded.
how speakers and hearers interact with each other to make meaning in a particular communicative situation.
the relationship between grammatical constructions and the frames in which they are deployed.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a frames based approach to the study of grammar is a useful addition to construction grammarians’ toolkits.
interactional frames are key to understanding grammatical structures in context, and that grammatical constructions are key to understanding the dynamics of language use in context
interactional frames and grammatically constructions have a strong correlation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to understand how the grammatical structure of the language is related to the communicative situation.

it is a contribution to the study of grammar and discourse in the sense of the two fields of linguistics that have traditionally been kept apart, and that we are interested in the interaction between grammar and discourse in a way that goes beyond the sentence, and that is not limited to the analysis of a single grammatical phenomenon.
it is an attempt to integrate the concerns of grammatical description with those of interactional analysis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
grammatical constructions and interactive frames are inextricably intertwined.
grammatical constructions are best understood within the context of the interactive frame in which they occur.
grammatical constructions and interactive frames are not only related, they are in fact inseparable.
